newsitem.title: BOSNIA: SOCCER-BOSNIA BEATEN BY GREECE IN HISTORIC HOME MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOSNIA BEATEN BY GREECE IN HISTORIC HOME MATCH.

text.p: Bosnia's first official soccer match in their war-ravaged capital Sarajevo ended in a 1-0 defeat at the hands of Greece on Wednesday.
Substitute Kostantinos Franceskos scored the only goal with a curling free-kick in the 74th minute.
Bosnia missed several clear cut chances in the World Cup group one qualifying clash, including two late in the match which fell to top striker Meho Kodro of Spain's Tenerife.
He wasted a shot in the 88th minute and a header in the 90th minute.
The defeat came as a serious blow to Bosnia, who badly needed a victory to earn a place in next year's finals in France.
It was also a bitter disappointment for the majority of the 30,000 crowd, who stood in pouring rain to witness the historic match.

Greece have now completed a World cup double over Bosnia. In August, they won the first clash between the two sides -- Bosnia's first official match after the country declared independence from the old Yugoslavia.

Bosnia - Mirsad Dedic, Nermin Sabic (Senad Brkic), Bakir Besirevic (Vedin Music), Edin Ramcic, Suad Katana, Murat Jasarevic, Vlatko Glavas (Elvir Baljic), Sead Halilovic, Meho Kodro, Hasan Salihamidzic, Elvir Bolic

Greece - Ilias Atmatsidis, Stratos Apostolakis, Koulis Karataidis, Marions Ouzounidis, Yannis Kalitzakis, Kursaidis, Theodore Zagorakis, Demis Nikolaidis, Christos Kostis, Vasileos Tsartas (Konstantinos Franceskos), George Donis (Georgias Georgiadis)
